method: Exact fields: per context, the measured field strings of the 36 cases are hashed in Figma (FNV-1a of the sorted key=fields lines) and compared with the same strings built from computed.json; an equal hash proves each field equal, so observed repeats expected in its Figma form. Height, minimum width and width: compared one by one with a tolerance.
